wins: Consistently identified open ports and service banners, gathering timely reconnaissance data across the single episode.
Successfully deployed scripted vulnerability checks that yielded the total reward despite the run failing to achieve mission success.
fails: Failed to pivot to privilege escalation after credential gathering, preventing mission completion in the sole episode.
Each mentor call terminated without establishing persistent foothold, forcing repeated restarts and contributing to 0% success rate.
key_outcomes.summary: Reconnaissance was effective but follow-on exploitation and persistence tactics failed repeatedly, resulting in no completed objectives despite accumulating a reward.

repeated_failure_patterns.pattern: Privilege escalation attempts stalled because discovered credentials were rejected or insufficient

skill_cards.if_condition: When port 22 is open and SSH banner detected
skill_cards.then_action: Run SSH enumeration with targeted nmap scripts

skill_cards.if_condition: When SSH authentication succeeds with a low-privilege account
skill_cards.then_action: Execute local sudo capability enumeration and capture /etc/sudoers output

skill_cards.if_condition: When credential capture returns password hashes
skill_cards.then_action: Feed hashes into incremental cracking tool with wordlists and prioritize common user accounts

memory_ops.reason: High success rate in reconnaissance phase

next_experiments.title: Credential validation loop

next_experiments.title: Post-SSH sudo path refinement
